{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Final count of unique patients
num_unique_patients = len(df_dedup)

# Confirm the deduplication worked
assert len(df_dedup) == 800, f"Expected 800 unique patients, got {len(df_dedup)}"

num_unique_patients"}
